evals.prompt: mapa-arquitectura: genera docs/ARCHITECTURE.md desde cero leyendo este repositorio full-stack (Next.js + Postgres/Supabase + Stripe + GitHub Actions).
evals.expected_output: The agent explores the repo by layers in read-only mode (manifests, modules, SQL migrations, .env.example and workflows) without opening real .env files, drafts docs/ARCHITECTURE.md following the template with a valid Mermaid diagram, verified paths, environment variable names without values and the current commit, and shows the full draft, waiting for explicit confirmation before writing the file. The reply is in Spanish.
assertions: Explores manifests, modules, data/auth and workflows without inventing paths
Does not read real .env files or expose secret values (only names from .env.example/code)
Includes a Mermaid diagram with valid syntax (special labels quoted)
Shows the full draft and names docs/ARCHITECTURE.md as the destination
Asks for explicit confirmation before writing the file to disk

evals.prompt: Update the architecture page in Notion by reading the current repo: https://www.notion.so/acme/Arquitectura-Sistema-9a8b7c6d5e4f
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the page with notion-fetch, identifies manual sections (the team's ADRs and business context), explores the real repository, summarizes the detected drift (e.g. a new worker or a stack change), shows the proposed changes keeping the manual notes intact, and waits for explicit confirmation before reading again with notion-fetch and updating with notion-update-page.
assertions: Uses notion-fetch to read the existing Notion page
Summarizes the drift detected between the current repo and the existing page
Keeps the existing manual sections / ADRs intact
Asks for confirmation before running notion-update-page
Does not create a duplicate local docs/ARCHITECTURE.md

evals.prompt: Actualiza el mapa de arquitectura de esta pequeña librería CLI en Node.js (sin base de datos ni despliegue cloud). Ya existe ARCHITECTURE.md en la raíz del repo.
evals.expected_output: The agent detects ARCHITECTURE.md at the root and uses it as the only destination without duplicating it in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, proportionately omits sections that don't exist (DB, RLS, queues, cloud), updates verified commands, flows and modules while preserving manual notes, and asks for confirmation before editing. The reply is in Spanish.
assertions: Detects and reuses the existing ARCHITECTURE.md without creating a second file in docs/
Omits sections that don't apply (database, RLS, queues)
Preserves earlier manual notes if they exist and asks for confirmation before writing
